# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native, single-file portrait game titled **Burn Book Blitz: Social Status Strategy**. Preserve the mechanics of a five-turn branching story choice game: start overlay, three large choices per scene, three numeric meters, immediate score update after each tap, compact reaction feedback, final ending after the fifth choice selected by the highest meter with a low-score fail fallback, and a restart button.

Theme every safe surface around: Mean Girls social-status strategy. A Mean Girls social-status strategy game with clique warfare, savage one-liners, pink-coded high school politics, rumor combat, performative popularity, and glossy teen satire with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player is the New Plastic Strategist. The three meters are Popularity, Receipts, and Heat. Scenes move through locker row, cafeteria court, group chat, bathroom mirror, and pep-rally feed. Use hot-pink school politics, Burn Book notes, locker stripes, cafeteria-light gradients, savage one-liners, glossy stickers, and procedural canvas rumor particles. Keep controls mobile-first, readable, and tap-friendly in portrait aspect ratios.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: mobile-first branching story choice game with procedural canvas ambience.
- objective: make five sequential choices, build one of three affinity scores, and receive an ending based on the dominant score.
- input model: tap/click start, then tap/click one of three large choice buttons per turn, then tap/click restart from ending.
- core loop: read scene → choose one of three tactics → update one meter → show compact feedback → advance turn → resolve ending after turn five.
- fail/friction state: low total momentum after five turns resolves to a failure-style ending; otherwise dominant meter selects one of three ending families.

## Protected Mechanics
- Five scripted turns with three choices each.
- Three accumulating meters displayed in the HUD.
- Per-choice score deltas applied immediately on click/tap.
- Ending selected only after the final turn by highest meter with a low-score fail threshold.
- Start and restart overlays; user-gesture-safe audio lifecycle; canvas is presentation-only.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD labels, scene copy, speaker names, ending copy, visual forms, canvas background, color system, feedback captions, GIF choice, font choice, and audio mood are safe to transform because they do not alter the state machine.
